title: REST 读取权限目录
expected: 权限目录非空且分组固定

title: RBAC 页面加载
expected: 角色树含系统内置/自定义分组，权限树渲染

title: 系统内置角色渲染
expected: 超级管理员/管理员/普通用户 均在树中
actual: {"超级管理员": true, "管理员": true, "普通用户": true}

title: 新建角色 · 权限树初始态
expected: 所有分组未选中（无半选）
actual: 分组状态=[["开放接入", false, false], ["账号", false, false], ["备份", false, false], ["岗位", false, false], ["职业事实", false, false], ["简历", false, false], ["角色与权限", false, false], ["设置", false, false], ["用户", false, false]]

title: 勾选 resume:read · 三态-半选
actual: 简历={"label": "简历", "code": null, "isFolder": true, "checked": false, "indeterminate": true, "disabled": false} resume:read={"label": "读取简历", "code": "resume:read", "isFolder": false, "checked": true, "indeterminate": false, "disabled": false}

title: 再勾选 resume:write · 三态-全选
expected: 「简历」分组 checked=true 且非半选
actual: {"label": "简历", "code": null, "isFolder": true, "checked": true, "indeterminate": false, "disabled": false}

title: 取消 resume:read · 回到半选
actual: {"label": "简历", "code": null, "isFolder": true, "checked": false, "indeterminate": true, "disabled": false}

title: 勾选 resume:read/write + jd:read · 三态组合
expected: 简历已全选、岗位半选、账号未选
actual: 简历={"label": "简历", "code": null, "isFolder": true, "checked": true, "indeterminate": false, "disabled": false} 岗位={"label": "岗位", "code": null, "isFolder": true, "checked": false, "indeterminate": true, "disabled": false} 账号={"label": "账号", "code": null, "isFolder": true, "checked": false, "indeterminate": false, "disabled": false}

title: 创建自定义角色
expected: REST 中角色存在且权限=['resume:read', 'resume:write', 'jd:read']
actual: created={"id": "role_e2e_rbac_1791528987_519143", "code": "e2e_rbac_1791528987", "name": "E2E 权限测试角色", "description": "E2E 自动化创建的临时角色", "rank": 0, "isSystem": false, "permissions": ["jd:read", "resume:read", "resume:write"]}

title: 刷新后重新选中角色 · 权限回显一致
expected: resume:read/write、jd:read 勾选；简历全选/岗位半选
actual: clicked=True resume:read=True resume:write=True jd:read=True 简历={"label": "简历", "code": null, "isFolder": true, "checked": true, "indeterminate": false, "disabled": false} 岗位={"label": "岗位", "code": null, "isFolder": true, "checked": false, "indeterminate": true, "disabled": false} account:read=False

title: 角色详情显示权限计数
修改角色名称与权限
expected: REST 权限=['resume:read', 'jd:read', 'account:read'] 且名称=E2E 权限测试角色-改
actual: {"id": "role_e2e_rbac_1791528987_519143", "code": "e2e_rbac_1791528987", "name": "E2E 权限测试角色-改", "description": "E2E 自动化创建的临时角色", "rank": 0, "isSystem": false, "permissions": ["account:read", "jd:read", "resume:read"]}

title: 修改后刷新回显一致
expected: resume:read、jd:read、account:read 勾选；简历/账号半选
actual: resume:read=True resume:write=False jd:read=True account:read=True 账号={"label": "账号", "code": null, "isFolder": true, "checked": false, "indeterminate": true, "disabled": false} 简历={"label": "简历", "code": null, "isFolder": true, "checked": false, "indeterminate": true, "disabled": false}

title: 系统角色只读
expected: 显示只读提示且无删除按钮

title: REST 修改系统角色被拒
expected: 422 且提示系统角色不可修改
actual: status=422 body={"code": "VALIDATION_FAILED", "message": "系统角色不可修改"}
